convert_flux_transformer_checkpoint: convert a FLUX transformer checkpoint from safetensors to diffusers FluxTransformer2DModel format
convert_flux_vae_checkpoint: convert a FLUX VAE checkpoint from safetensors to diffusers AutoencoderKL format
load_original_checkpoint: load a FLUX checkpoint from HuggingFace Hub or a local safetensors file path
swap_scale_shift: swap the scale and shift chunks of an AdaLayerNormContinuous weight tensor for diffusers compatibility
run_flux_conversion: run the FLUX to diffusers conversion script with --transformer or --vae flags via argparse CLI
